data.name: Indrasen
data.gender_notes: Indrasen is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Indrasen is a Sanskrit name derived from Indra, the Hindu god of thunder, rain, and sky. The name Indrasen symbolizes the divine seed of Indra that brings forth life and prosperity. The name Indrasen carries the meaning “Lord Indra's seed” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Indrasen usually hope their child will grow to embody lord indra's seed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divine connection to the god of thunder and rain.
data.etymology: Indrasen belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Indra's seed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Indrasen total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

Indrasen is also mentioned in the Puranas, Hindu scriptures. He is considered the legendary king of the Haihayas and is known for his great vision and valor in battles.
